approval: Marc, in the review session: "(a) Adapter downloads + check,(b) Protocol-version runs"; then typed in this session: "Yes, run both".
method: Each client was given Wringer's server on its command line (claude -p --mcp-config FILE --strict-mcp-config; codex exec -c mcp_servers.wringer.command/args), pointing at a pass-through that logged every message the client sent and forwarded it unchanged to `wring mcp --connection` for a running scratch owner built from this release's source. The prompt asked only for the tool names and to call none.

server.answerToServerDiscover: JSON-RPC error -32000: Initialize this connection and send notifications/initialized before using tools.

claudeCode.binary: The Claude Code bundled with the Claude desktop app

agentMessage: The wringer MCP server’s tool names aren’t visible in the provided context.

limits: One run per client; a client's protocol choice may change with its version.

Claude Code sent server/discover before initialize. Wringer refused it, and Claude Code then initialized at 2025-11-25. What Claude Code does with a server that answers server/discover was not measured.

Codex called tools/list, but its model answered that the tool names were not visible to it. Why was not investigated; in beta gate run 2, codex exec with connect's enabled_tools did call Wringer's tools.
